subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: Should native `openclaw backup create` add exclude-pattern flags now, and if so should defaults or ignore-file loading be opt-in versus automatic?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior controls archive contents and security-sensitive recovery data, and the open implementation candidate already has unresolved proof and merge-risk signals.

options.title: Review and narrow the linked PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 as the implementation path after resolving proof, protected-path, external-asset, and default-loading semantics.

options.title: Keep design open before implementation
options.body: Leave the issue open while maintainers define the native backup filtering contract separately, then ask for a smaller PR against that contract.

options.title: Defer native support
options.body: Keep third-party recovery plugins as the recommended workaround and close or pause native exclude support only after maintainers explicitly reject core backup filtering.

recommendation.title: Review and narrow the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 as the implementation path after resolving proof, protected-path, external-asset, and default-loading semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent backup hardening and current implementation history make this the strongest available routing signal for the product/security decision.
